item.title: Full professor: Selection procedure for 1 position as a full professor, pursuant to Article 18, paragraphs 1 and 4-ter, of Law 240/2010 ("Parthenope" NAPOLI)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 23:59
Institution: "Parthenope" NAPOLI, Nola
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-06 Diritto amministrativo e pubblico

Professors currently holding a tenured full professorship (*Professore di prima fascia*), as well as scholars permanently based abroad and engaged in research or teaching activities at the university level—in positions equivalent to the one advertised—are NOT eligible to participate in this selection process.

item.description:

Institution: Univ. BRESCIA, Brescia
